data.exact_reserve_text: An overall release of prior year's provisions for claims during the year of approximately GBP 37.6m (2014: strengthening of GBP 0.3m) was primarily driven by the favourable experience on the Marine accounts in Aviation and Marine of GBP 54.7m (2014: release of GBP 15.8m), and Property and Fire release of GBP 5.3m (2014: release of GBP 3.6m).This is offset by the adverse experience on the Public Liability accounts in Third Party Liability of GBP 23.4m (2014: strengthening of GBP 20.8m).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Favourable experience on the Marine accounts in Aviation and Marine resulted in a release of reserves.
Property and Fire experienced favourable development resulting in a release of reserves.

prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse development on Public Liability (Third Party Liability)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse experience on Public Liability accounts (Third Party Liability) increased reserves.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded an overall gross release of prior-year claims reserves of approximately GBP 37.6m in 2015 (c. -6.4% of opening gross claims outstanding GBP 587.406m). This net release was driven largely by favourable development on Marine/Aviation (GBP 54.7m) and Property & Fire (GBP 5.3m) offset by adverse development on Third Party Liability/Casualty (GBP 23.4m).

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding) 2014 comparative column. Prior-year movement taken from Note 'Movement in Prior Year's Provision for Claims' which explicitly states an approx GBP 37.6m release (treated as gross). All amounts in the financial tables are presented in GBP '000. The claims development triangle (gross) is present and was used as cross-check. The Accident and health line shows a small negative premium (GBP (24)k) in the segmental table.
